messages:
Asha Rao: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: customer asks we commit to BYOK + 2yr immutable audit retention + S3 SSE-KMS. What can leadership promise in an RFP? Pinging @Vikram @Emily.

Vikram Rao: Short answer: BYOK cross-account for Dedicated -> pilot Q3, GA Q4. Private (VPC/on-prem) via adapter next quarter. 2yr retention = supported via export to customer-owned S3 with Object Lock + SSE-KMS. We will provide docs and IAM snippets.

Emily Nguyen: Compliance note: we supply company SOC2 Type II and ISO-27001 certs, plus a per-customer evidence bundle (configs, KMS/IAM policies, audit extracts). We can't provide per-customer SOC2 attestation. Evidence-bundle export via Console targeted for beta end of Q4.

Jess Ortega: Implementation detail: BYOK uses challenge-response; we never import private key material. For S3 exports we'll assume an IAM role in the customer's account; docs will include role policy and example. I'll draft an RFP appendix with technical snippets and a retention/pricing table.

Security Bot: Office hours scheduled: https://cal.com/redwood/security-officehours — sign up to review RFP language and copy.

Asha Rao: Great, please @mention here when the appendix and IAM snippets are live. I'll update the RFP and send to the customer.
